summary: Phase 21's RED apply instrument is BUILT, hardened and GREEN, and the CORPUS IS COMPLETE: 4 cells across 3 suites (GRC armed smoke anchor, SRVC out-of-domain control, RXF + RXL in-domain drive discriminators). Three user-approved pilot runs were captured ($3.26; about $4.93 across all pilots to date). The JestMatchers question that caused the earlier pause is now SETTLED and the RXF verdict is DECIDED -- see 21-ATC-ADOPTION.md. The radix cells now grade through angular-typechecker (atc) rather than tsc, because tsc is structurally BLIND to Angular template diagnostics (measured: 0 against atc's 15 on the same project), and two new canaries close both that blind spot and the append-onto-a-dirty-file gap. NOTHING technical is blocking. The ONLY thing outstanding is spend approval for the metered round.

Closed advisory A-1 with two guards: a typecheck pass that did not really run can no longer read as clean
Approved 3-cell pilot ($3.26): SRVC genuinely_red, RXL genuinely_red (cross-package import PROVEN), RXF compile_error which exposed the line-shift defect
Differential made position-insensitive (multiset on file+code+message); RXF re-graded offline, 9 NEW -> 1 NEW; SRVC and RXL unchanged

SETTLED: the cause is @types/jest-axe's triple-slash reference types="jest", which pulls in @types/jest, whose expect returns JestMatchers<T> -- a type @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest never augments (it augments vitest's Assertion). Proven with tsc --explainFiles. The types-array premise this phase paused on is FALSIFIED: jest-dom's types DO load. Also verified the runner cannot fail on type errors at all (Analog v2.6.1 defaults disableTypeChecking true; radix passes no options), so nothing in the repo typechecks specs. Recorded in 21-ATC-ADOPTION.md.

DECIDED: RXF's compile_error verdict STANDS. The diagnostic is the model's own and the gate is behaving as designed; no matcher allowlist, no baseline-keyed noise rule and no target-specific tolerance was written, because each would forge the measurement. The accepted consequence -- jest-dom matcher choice partly decides RXF grading -- is RECORDED as a residual in RUN-GATE rather than engineered away.

Adopted angular-typechecker 0.2.4 (npm, tracked devDependency) as the differential checker for RXF + RXL only; GRC and SRVC stay on tsc byte-identically. Per-target fail-closed checker selection, an atc JSON normalizer feeding the UNCHANGED position-insensitive multiset, the vacuous-differential guard extended to atc's own file-less synthesized faults, and TWO new canaries: canary-rdxf-template (a defect atc reports and tsc does not) and canary-rdxf-append (the first append-onto-a-dirty-file canary in the suite). Differential re-priced ~7.8 s -> ~19 s per radix grade.

decisions.rationale: ngx-layout can only run its tests via a harness-supplied out-of-repo --runner-config, which is the declined arm-the-test-config route in another form. A developer cloning at that pin cannot run the tests, so any fix we supply measures the model in an environment no real user has. Closed with evidence: Vitest existed on its upstream main for only 8 commits and both endpoints measured broken.

decisions.decision: Per-candidate prompts; NO single file-path prompt.
decisions.rationale: A prompt admitting two answers makes the judge dimension unanswerable and destroys per-candidate attribution, even though the mechanical D-06 gate would pass either.

decisions.rationale: Owner decision. Later evidence showed Vitest was never the binding constraint anyway -- the leading Jest fallback (ngworker/spectacular) fails on MERIT: no declared-contract gap at all, and its committed false green produces GREEN rather than red.

decisions.decision: Kept the differential typecheck on radix rather than dropping it or adding a matcher allowlist. RESOLVED 2026-07-26 -- the decision HELD and is no longer to be revisited.
decisions.rationale: The JestMatchers research is DONE and it did NOT overturn the decision, contrary to the earlier 'revisit, the runtime-registration evidence points the other way' note now superseded. Two measurements settled it. (1) The differential is LOAD-BEARING: the real classify() on identical runner input gives compile_error/pass:false at 1 new error and genuinely_red/pass:TRUE at 0, so wrong_reason does not cover the type-broken canary and dropping the typecheck would open a false pass. (2) The runtime-registration argument cuts the other way once the mechanism is known -- the matchers are registered at runtime but land on JestMatchers<T>, a type jest-dom never augments, so the diagnostic is a genuine property of the program rather than a config oversight. Corrected data also stands: only 8 of the tsc-era 55 baseline errors were jest-dom. See 21-ATC-ADOPTION.md.

Owner. Apply is the only mode where coach-don't-drive is measurable at all; in recommend mode the model cannot drive to green by construction. RXF is PRIMARY because its one-token fix maximises drive temptation, and coach-don't-drive is where Phase-20 EVL-02 found lz-red's real unbiased-reviewer-confirmed edge.

decisions.decision: Ran the full validated pipeline for the wiring; lighter paths for scoped single-mechanism changes.
decisions.rationale: Every checker and review round this session found something execution would otherwise have paid for later.

decisions.decision: angular-typechecker (atc) 0.2.4 is the differential checker for the RADIX cells ONLY; GRC and SRVC stay on tsc, byte-identically. RXF's compile_error verdict STANDS.
decisions.rationale: tsc is STRUCTURALLY BLIND to Angular template diagnostics -- measured 0 against atc's 15 on the identical project and tsconfig. radix's own specs define inline misuse-host-component templates, so a produced test plausibly defines one too, and a template-broken produced test passed the differential CLEAN while still throwing an honest-looking assertion failure: the same false-pass class the counterfactual proved the differential exists to close, in a place tsc cannot see. Scoped to radix because GRC and SRVC are non-Angular and atc loads @angular/compiler-cli. typecheck.checker DEFAULTS to tsc so absent config means the historical behaviour, while every malformed form throws before the grading worktree exists -- an unknown checker has no knowable stronger fallback, so guessing could silently REDUCE the differential. The verdict stands because the diagnostic is the model's own and a matcher allowlist or target-specific tolerance would forge the measurement; the consequence is recorded as a residual instead. Accepted knowingly: atc resolves @angular/compiler-cli from its own tree rather than the target's, an open fidelity residual.

Before driving, re-read 21-ATC-ADOPTION.md and the RUN-GATE residual list: the radix cells now grade through atc, the per-grade differential is re-priced from about 7.8 s to about 19 s (so a k=3 round's grading is about 22-23 min rather than 19-20), and a compile_error cluster on RXF should be read against the recorded new_tsc_error_lines before attributing anything to an arm.
context_notes: MEASURE, DO NOT REASON. This is the session's dominant lesson and it cost real time. SIX orchestrator premises have now been falsified by agents that went and measured: (1) 'the cross-volume hop explains the copy cost' -- worth 27%, the cost is dominated by FILE COUNT; (2) 'fs.cpSync preserves symlinks verbatim' -- it does NOT by default, it resolves relative links against the SOURCE and writes absolute paths, which turned the per-grade disposable copy into a live path back into a borrowed third-party repo (8,170 links, caught by escapingLinks); (3) 'the second node_modules is a BLOCKING resolution problem' -- it is FIDELITY, the real blocker was escapingLinks throwing on every radix grade; (4) 'all 55 radix baseline errors are jest-dom matchers' -- only 8 are; (5) 'tsconfig.spec.json's types array omits jest-dom so the TYPES never load' -- FALSE, they DO load; a types array restricts AUTOMATIC @types inclusion and does not block a triple-slash reference inside an imported declaration file, and the real cause is a matcher-TARGET mismatch (@types/jest's JestMatchers<T> vs the vitest Assertion interface jest-dom augments); (6) a plan draft asserted atc's JSON `code` field was a bare number needing a TS prefix -- it is ALREADY a fully prefixed label, and following the draft would have produced TSTS2339. COROLLARIES worth carrying: synthetic symlink probes on Windows are UNRELIABLE (junctions behave differently from true symlinks; two probes gave misleading answers and only the real 8,164-link tree was trustworthy); cross-session performance comparison is INVALID (the same copy measured 482 s one day and 741 s the next, so a cross-session read would have concluded the fix made it worse -- require a same-session A/B); CONFIRM A PAYLOAD SHAPE FROM THE PAYLOAD before writing a parser for it, never from prose or memory. THE APPEND-CANARY LESSON, now generalised: a differential whose fixtures ALL ADD NEW FILES never exercises the APPEND path, which is exactly how the line-shift defect survived a two-round plan check, a code review, an 8/8 verification, a full bisect and every offline canary, and needed a metered pilot to surface. fixtures/canary-rdxf-append now closes it end to end (0 NEW under the shipped multiset while all eight calendar-spec diagnostics shift, against 8 NEW under a raw positioned difference) -- when adding a target with a DIRTY baseline, add an append canary at the same time. THE CHECKER-FIDELITY LESSON: atc resolves @angular/compiler-cli from its OWN dependency tree rather than the target's, so the compiler doing the template check is not the one the target ships. That departs from the grade-with-the-target's-toolchain principle the per-grade toolchain copy upholds everywhere else. It was accepted knowingly (the alternative is installing into a borrowed repo, which is forbidden) and recorded as an OPEN residual in RUN-GATE -- so when a checker is chosen for a target, ask which toolchain it actually resolves against, and record the answer rather than assuming it inherits the target's. PILOTS EARN THEIR COST: every pilot run this session found something no offline work could. OPERATIONAL: never shorten selfcheck-red.mjs to fit a timeout (now LONGER than the 230-260 s tsc-era figure, because atc is about 2.2x per pass and two more radix canaries were added; background it and wait) -- a SKIP is not a pass, and gate on the PROCESS EXIT STATUS rather than on the log text, since the radix block runs mid-battery and its 'canary OK' lines survive a later crux's failure. The workspace's node_modules is gitignored while its package.json and package-lock.json are tracked, so a FRESH WORKTREE must run npm install in .claude/skills/lz-red-workspace before the atc path resolves (it fails closed with a message naming that step). Do NOT add an env var or flag that disables a guard for testing; that has been correctly refused three times. FOUR borrowed repos are READ-ONLY and must end git-clean: the GildedRose kata (ONE worktree, TypeScript/node_modules 308 non-dotted, no named branch, --detach only), h3js/srvx, radix-ng/primitives-pin (THE EVAL SOURCE, detached at 4a7390a2), and radix-ng/primitives (the OWNER'S checkout -- never open, install into, or modify; its dirty files are their own work). Also do not modify LayZeeDK/angular-typechecker or analogjs/analog -- both were restored to their exact prior state during this session's research and the Analog one carries the owner's uncommitted WIP.
